title: Finite etale pushforwards and unit quotients are locally finite free
statement: For a commutative condensed coefficient object Lambda and the normalized internal module functors of [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-point-pullback], let p:U\to X be finite etale surjective [lem-weil-pbc-finite-etale-etale-local-split]. Local finite freeness means the existence of a pro-etale cover on which the raw inverse-image modules are isomorphic to finite sums of the pulled coefficient ring. Then (1) p_*M is locally finite free whenever M is locally finite free on U; and (2) the cokernel of P\to p_*p^*P is locally finite free whenever P is locally finite free on X. No noetherian hypothesis or dimension bound on coefficients is imposed.

proof.text: At every point choose an etale neighbourhood splitting p. Surjectivity makes its finite sheet set nonempty. Reindex by Fin n. Construct the etale cover with an abstract member predicate, then specialize the predicate to local finite freeness; weaken it to a pro-etale cover. The two private generic cover helpers in the item are fully proved using the existing Mathlib cover pullback and mkOfCovers constructions.

On a splitting neighbourhood use the canonical module product comparison. Pull local free covers to the sheets and form their finite common refinement. Use Classical.skolem to keep the chosen covers abstract. Finite products of finite free modules are finite free by flattening biproduct indices, and PreservesProduct.iso transports this to inverse images of products.

Naturality and the left triangle equation identify the unit components with inverse-image composition isomorphisms. After their inverses the unit is diagonal. The automorphism subtracting one selected coordinate sends it to the selected biproduct injection. Use cokernelBiproductIotaIso to identify its cokernel with the sum on the other indices; this is locally finite free.

Exact inverse image commutes with the cokernel. Reuse the generic exists_cover_of_local_property helper of Sheaf.Paper.CondensedQbarLfpCoverComposition to bind the local covers, specializing its abstract member predicate to normalized local freeness. This helper has no padic or noetherian assumptions. Transport between raw pulled coefficients and normalized coefficients along condensedPullbackHom and its inverse. The free_map, free_comap, free_pullback and free_of_iso helpers are reused through proof-only import all of Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.CondensedConstructibleSerre.

theorem finiteEtale_locallyFree_models
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] {X U : Scheme.{u}} (p : U ⟶ X)
    [IsFinite p] [Etale p] [Surjective p] :
    (∀ M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ U),
      (∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage U, ∀ s : C.I₀,
        Mod.IsFree ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).obj (condensedRingObj Λ U))
          (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).mapMod _).obj M)) →
      ∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ s : C.I₀,
        Mod.IsFree ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).obj (condensedRingObj Λ X))
          (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).mapMod _).obj ((lowerStar Λ p).obj M))) ∧
    (∀ P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X),
      (∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ s : C.I₀,
        Mod.IsFree ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).obj (condensedRingObj Λ X))
          (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).mapMod _).obj P)) →
      ∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ s : C.I₀,
        Mod.IsFree ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).obj (condensedRingObj Λ X))
          (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).mapMod _).obj
            (cokernel ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction Λ p).unit.app P))))
